title: MV Is there a plugin that would allow to adjust tile while mapping?

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body:
Let's assume i need to place a chair. But the chair does not fit the character model, it needs to be few pixels above it's current position, but still in the same tile. Normally i would go into tileset and adjust position of specific tile (and most likely make a copy of it so it would not chage other maps), but perhaps there are plugin to do such things right in the mapping, just drag and drop to displace the position of your current tile a bit? I don't even know why there isn't a default function like that.
p.s Some kind of layered mapping would also be great, that would allow to change bottom layer without affecting the top.

posts.author: wiffle88
posts.body: If you have access to the Yanfly plugins, Yanfly's doodads are great for this.  If I remember right, you can nudge things by half tiles or by pixels.  The doodads are also layer-able.  Been a while since I used it, but it's a pretty flexible plugin, able to have stuff be triggered by switches or variables as well.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
tiles in general does not have offsets, you have to use events to draw
B-E tiles, from there, you can offset them by several plugins.
like the one linked above or from another author, depends on the plugins
you use for better compability.
I don't know if the linked plugin use comments or notetags, but I highly
YEP_EventOffset or another that uses comments as well, as this is better
if you need to target pages or move routes as well.
